title: Zesty Roasted Uruguayan Corned Beef Wrap
description: A hearty solo dinner dish featuring roasted corned beef wrapped in leaves and steamed to perfection, this Uruguayan dish is keto-friendly and full of flavor. It is a unique blend of textures with the chewy corned beef and crispy leaf wrap.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced corned beef to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the spice mixture.
Spread the corned beef out in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the corned beef is roasting, prepare the collard green leaves by washing and drying them thoroughly.
Remove the corned beef from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
To assemble the wraps, lay a collard green leaf flat on a work surface and place a few slices of the roasted corned beef in the center of the leaf.
Drizzle the corned beef with lemon juice and fold the leaf over the filling to form a tight wrap.
Place the wraps in a steamer basket and steam over boiling water for 5 minutes.
Serve the wraps hot and enjoy.
